name: GOHUB
recent: Go Hub Capital 于 2026 年 10 月获得 KTMB 价值 RM64.79 million 的票务系统合约，并在 11 月公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，9 个月累计净利同比增长 56.96% 至 RM5.404 million。公司近期也出现独立非执行董事在闭市后交易窗口外减持股份，以及多名公司秘书与委员会成员变动。
notable: 获得 KTMB 价值 RM64.79 million 的票务系统合约。
2026 财年第三季度业绩：9 个月累计净利同比增长 56.96% 至 RM5.404 million。
独立非执行董事 Alief Iskandar Bin Mohd Zuhri 在闭市后交易窗口外减持 412,900 股普通股。
risks: 独立非执行董事在闭市后交易窗口外减持股份，涉及 412,900 股（0.094%）。
多名公司秘书及提名、审计、薪酬委员会成员出现变动。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 RM15.403 million，环比增长 8.3%，同比增长 37.0%；净利为 RM1.806 million，环比增长 1.7%，同比增长 24.3%；净利率为 11.7%，低于上一季度的 12.5%。

recent_en: Go Hub Capital secured a RM64.79 million ticketing system contract from KTMB in October 2026 and reported 9M FY2026 net profit up 56.96% year-on-year to RM5.404 million in November. The company also saw an independent non-executive director dispose of shares outside a closed period and several changes in company secretaries and board committees.
notable_en: Secured a RM64.79 million ticketing system contract from KTMB.
9M FY2026 net profit rose 56.96% year-on-year to RM5.404 million.
Independent Non-Executive Director Alief Iskandar Bin Mohd Zuhri disposed of 412,900 ordinary shares outside a closed period.
risks_en: An independent non-executive director disposed of 412,900 shares (0.094%) outside a closed period.
Several changes in company secretaries and members of the nomination, audit and remuneration committees.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was RM15.403 million, up 8.3% QoQ and 37.0% YoY; net income was RM1.806 million, up 1.7% QoQ and 24.3% YoY; net margin was 11.7%, down from 12.5% in the previous quarter.
